description: This file defines the BasicAccessStrategy class within the OrangeHRM Maintenance Plugin. It implements a method for accessing entity records related to employee numbers, extending the AccessStrategy base class.

classes.name: BasicAccessStrategy
classes.description: A class that provides access control logic based on employee number, extending the base AccessStrategy class.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Retrieves and processes access entity records for a given employee number, returning an array of data related to access control.
